quality.title: Data quality (step 6)
quality.intro: Checks whether the imported samples can be trusted before any diagnosis. Samples are never changed or deleted: excluded samples are recorded in quarantine with a reason. Real process excursions are not quarantined.
quality.uncalibrated: Ruleset v0-uncalibrated: thresholds are starting values until calibrated on real runs. Each check is kept; a new check does not replace the previous one.
quality.readOnly: Only Admin and Engineer can run the quality check.
quality.none: No quality check has been run for this run yet.

diagnosis.title: State refresh and diagnosis
diagnosis.intro: Diagnosis works only on data that passed the quality check. A cause is named only when every precondition passes; otherwise the result lists what is missing. No cause is ever guessed.
diagnosis.refreshHint: Rebuilds the run's picture from clean samples only (after the latest quality check) and stores it with a SHA-256 fingerprint. Earlier snapshots are kept.
diagnosis.readOnly: Only Admin and Engineer can refresh the state and run the diagnosis.
diagnosis.noSnapshot: No state snapshot yet. Run the quality check first, then refresh the state.
diagnosis.gatesHint: Checked on the latest snapshot. Samples outside confirmed limits are evidence for the diagnosis, not quarantined.
diagnosis.noDiagnosis: Preconditions have not been checked yet.
diagnosis.stale: Checked on an older snapshot — check again.

audit.title: Audit
audit.hint: An audit record is a sealed snapshot of one run's evidence, built by the database with a SHA-256 hash and linked to the previous record. Records cannot be changed.

audit.integrityHint: Checked by the database on every view: the stored snapshot must hash to this value and link to the previous record. The export contains only allowlisted fields.
audit.sealHint: Sealing stores the run's current evidence as an unchangeable, hash-chained record. Later data needs a new seal.

failLoop.title: FAIL loop
failLoop.hint: Starts from a VERIFIED_FAIL. Working canon: DECOMPOSITION → DIAGNOSIS → 3 → 6 → 28 → STATE REFRESH → REPAIR → TEST → VERIFICATION → 38 → 39 → 40 → CROSS → AUDIT. Each step is an unchangeable record that points at real evidence; the database enforces the order (docs/CANON.md).
failLoop.rule: A repair that ends in FAIL, INCONCLUSIVE or INCOMPLETE is recorded at step 38, which closes the case; it never becomes knowledge. After step 40 the case is read-only.
failLoop.closeReason: Close before verification: reason (kept, never knowledge)
failLoop.knowledgeRule: Only what was erroneous at step 3 and, after the repair, has a verified PASS with saved evidence, re-checked at step 39, becomes knowledge. One record per case, unchangeable.

stepHint.DECOMPOSITION: Recorded automatically from the failing verification.
stepHint.DIAGNOSIS: Pick a diagnosis of the failed run made after the previous step. After a state refresh: only a diagnosis of the base state from step 28. Without a named cause (DIAGNOSED, engine only) the loop goes through 3 → 6 → 28 again; a cause is never forced.
stepHint.EXTRACT: 3: pick a data-quality assessment of the failed run. The database separates correct from erroneous (signals and product items); nothing is repaired yet.
stepHint.PURGE: 6: the database marks what step 3 found erroneous as excluded and rejects the failed plan. Raw data stays available for the audit; the process status changes, not the history.
stepHint.CONSOLIDATE: 28: pick the state snapshot built from step 3's assessment (clean samples only). This is the stable base state.
stepHint.STATE_REFRESH: The state from step 28 becomes the current base. Refused if a newer state exists.
stepHint.INTERVENTION: Pick a new plan for the same machine, created after the case opened, and describe the changes and why.
stepHint.CONTROLLED_TEST: Pick a completed run on the repair plan. Starting it needed an approved decision (database rule).
stepHint.VERIFICATION: Pick a verification of the controlled test run. It sets the case outcome; 38 decides what follows.
stepHint.FILTER: 38: the evidence gate before 39 and 40. Only what was erroneous at step 3 and now has a verified PASS with saved evidence passes. Anything else is recorded here and the case closes.
stepHint.VERIFY_PERSIST: 39: the database re-checks the current measurements and persists the 38 result as knowledge. A new bad measurement blocks it.
stepHint.LOCK: 40: the state is verified, persisted and locked against accidental change (no numeric threshold). After this step the case is read-only.
stepHint.CROSS: A new cycle starts from the locked state: the repair plan is the new baseline.
stepHint.AUDIT: Seal the audit of the controlled test run (run page) and pick that record. The seal contains this case; the case closes.

failLoop.threshold: state verified, persisted and locked (no numeric threshold); case read-only
failLoop.gateClosed: stopped: not a verified PASS with evidence; case closed, never knowledge
